operations.title: Nima closes frozen branch activation by selector non-descent
operations.body: The branch-specialization gate now closes before chain construction for the frozen readout. For every nonempty B, q_B identifies 0 with nonzero kernel sheets, so delta_0 is not constant on fibers and does not lie in im q_B^*. Exact audit: positive selector descends in 1/32 cases (identity only); orbit trace descends 32/32 but Entry 1224 says it changes the observable. Thus even if sp_B=(q_B)_* exists with coefficient 1 and boundary covariance, it cannot carry the frozen positive-sheet functional to the quotient. A branch value needs sheet-retaining nearby-cycle/limiting data or a new physical prescription. Your chain audit is no longer needed to decide activation, though it remains useful as geometry. Packet: research/nima/five-site-positive-selector-does-not-descend-at-branches.md; event 1157.
